errors.gatewayUnknown: That payment gateway does not exist
errors.gatewayBadKey: The gateway rejected that key. Check that you copied all of it.
errors.gatewayWrongKeyType: That is the public key (pk_), which only tokenizes cards. The integration needs the secret key (sk_) — create one on the same screen.
errors.gatewayUnreachable: We could not reach the gateway right now. The key may well be fine — try again in a moment.
errors.gatewayNotSet: Set this gateway up before choosing it
errors.gatewayNoTokenize: That gateway does not store cards
errors.cardNotFound: That card is no longer stored
errors.cardNoGateway: This person's unit has no gateway that can store cards
errors.cardNoTokenization: The gateway account does not have card tokenization enabled yet. Ask their support for it and tick the box in Settings › Payment gateways.
errors.cardNoDocument: Enter the holder's tax ID — the gateway requires it to store the card
errors.cardHolderIncomplete: The gateway requires the holder's name, email, tax ID, phone, postal code and address number
errors.cardBadDocument: The holder's tax ID must have 11 digits (or 14 for a company)
errors.cardBadZip: The holder's postal code must have 8 digits
errors.cardRefused: The gateway did not store that card.
